# CBS Research Portal

> Institutional research repository and faculty directory for Copenhagen Business School, providing access to academic publications, student theses, and departmental research profiles.

The CBS Research Portal serves as the central hub for discovering and accessing research output from Copenhagen Business School's multiple departments and research centers. It functions as both an open-access repository for academic publications and a comprehensive directory of faculty expertise across business, economics, humanities, law, and digitalization disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Copenhagen Business School
- Institutional repository
- Research output
- Open access
- Department profiles
- Faculty directory

## Portal Home & Access

- [CBS Research Portal](https://research.cbs.dk): Main entry point for CBS Research Portal institutional repository
- [CBS Research Portal Homepage](https://research.cbs.dk/en/home): Homepage for CBS Research Portal with research database access
- [CBS Research Portal Index](https://research.cbs.dk/en/home/index): Index page for CBS Research Portal institutional repository

## Research Collections

- [Student Theses](https://research.cbs.dk/en/studentProjects): Repository of student theses and graduate research from CBS

## CBS Institution Profile

- [Copenhagen Business School](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/copenhagen-business-school): CBS institutional profile with research output and collaborations

## Academic Departments

- [Department of Accounting](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-accounting): Department of Accounting research profile and faculty directory
- [Department of Business Humanities and Law](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-business-humanities-and-law): Department profile for Business Humanities and Law research
- [Department of Digitalization](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-digitalization): Department of Digitalization research profile and collaborations
- [Department of Economics](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-economics): Department of Economics faculty directory and research output
- [Department of Finance](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-finance): Department of Finance research profiles and academic output
- [Department of International Economics, Government and Business](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-international-economics-government-and-business): International Economics, Government and Business department profile
- [Department of Management, Society and Communication](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-management-society-and-communication): Management, Society and Communication department research profile
